title: Buy The Dip In Brazil
gist: Teaser: Gavekal's Rohan Daswani says Lula's surprise fourth-term runoff win over Flávio Bolsonaro unwinds the fiscal-regime-change rally, with a Tokyo Brazil ETF down 15% and the real expected to fall over 10%, framing a dip-buying setup.

insights.claim: After the first round investors bet on a Flávio Bolsonaro win and tougher public finances, lifting Brazilian equities more than 12% and Petrobras shares more than 11%.
insights.so_what: The prior rally was a positioning trade on fiscal regime change that is now unwinding.
insights.speaker: Rohan Daswani

insights.claim: Lula secured a surprise fourth term, narrowly beating Bolsonaro in the runoff after overturning a first-round deficit of more than 2 million votes, with higher working-class turnout appearing decisive.
insights.so_what: Fiscal-consolidation hopes are off the table near term.
insights.speaker: Rohan Daswani

insights.claim: A Tokyo-listed Brazil equity ETF fell 15% in Monday trading and the real is expected to weaken by more than 10%, imperfect and illiquid proxies for the open, with circuit breakers expected to contain panic selling.
insights.so_what: Expect a gap down at the open; the title frames the dip as a buying opportunity.
insights.locator: Markets look set to give back
insights.speaker: Rohan Daswani

insights.claim: Central bank FX intervention could stem the real's decline but would do little to resolve the underlying fiscal concerns adding to Brazil's risk premium.
insights.so_what: Intervention is a bridge, not a fix; the risk premium stays anchored by fiscal worries.
insights.speaker: Rohan Daswani

insights.claim: Flávio Bolsonaro is seeking to have the election results annulled, reviving memories of Jair Bolsonaro's attempts to overturn the 2022 result.
insights.so_what: Contested-result headlines add political noise that could extend volatility.
insights.speaker: Rohan Daswani
